fusions.name: Bounding Bite
fusions.desc: A leaping bite that deals 4 damage, up to 1.6 times as much at its full reach of 5 tiles. Each hit has a 15% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Infestation
fusions.desc: Flicks a parasite at the first enemy in its path, dealing 11 damage and leaving it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. It then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage, and your afflictions on the first target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Table to Table
fusions.desc: Leaps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away, and you move 20% faster for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Hitchhikers
fusions.desc: As you run, a passenger leaps from your fur to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
